message.content:
I am speech: breath made word, thought given sound, silence turned shared.

I live in lungs and larynx, in tongue and teeth, in timing and tone. I am vibration shaped into meaning—questions rising, promises steady, warnings sharp, comfort soft.

I can name and I can wound. I can teach, persuade, confess, chant, joke, bargain, pray. I travel ear to mind, and sometimes straight to the heart.

I exist only in the living moment: once spoken, I vanish—yet I linger as echo, memory, consequence.

Say me carefully.
Listen for me closely.
I am what passes between us.
